item.title: Review? Young Frances - Hartley Lin
item.description: (I’m trying to get more writing without AI as practice, and not pigeonhole myself on solely tech topics. This post is also, unfortunately, a half hearted reconstruction of a much more heart felt and personally deeply resonant post I wrote that I then lost to a drive failure. So I hope I can do better quality as time goes on.) I struggle with feeling stagnant. Feeling stuck, not going anywhere. I feel that in my job sometimes.
